fusions.name: Downstroke
fusions.desc: A falling chop that deals 20 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target for 50% more damage per affliction. It leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Felling Descent
fusions.desc: You swoop onto an enemy up to 7 tiles away and bring the edge down for 16 damage, rising to 1.8 times that from the full 7 tiles.

fusions.name: Honed Membranes
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: The Blade Drinks
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
